_doc: Stills models for remote_stills_*.py, chosen by shots_to_jobs.py --model. Owner's rule (2026-11-25): step-distilled 'turbo' models are for drafts and layout only, never for anything that ships; their stills are stamped draft and render refuses them. 'default' is the model shots_to_jobs.py uses without --model. Every model here has commercially usable weights, with the licence read from its model card on the date given. full_gpu_gb, when set, is the card memory at which the whole pipeline goes on the GPU; below it the model loads one component at a time (default 1.5 x min_vram_gb). Excluded for licence: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev (non-commercial). offload 'sequential' moves one layer at a time onto the card when the pipeline doesn't fit whole (slowest, least memory). route 'codex' is not a Colab model: scripts/codex_stills.py makes its stills on the Mac.
default_note: Finished stills come from chatgpt-image-codex (scripts/codex_stills.py on the Mac), the owner's default since 2026-11-25. 'default' here is only the Colab route's fallback model when the Codex allowance runs short; the open-model bake-off (Qwen-Image 2512 sequential offload, MOSS-Image, Krea 2, FLUX 3 Klein) decides it.

z-image.licence: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face model card cardData.license, read by the Mac 2026-11-25). Full model; Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo is the distilled one.
z-image.bakeoff: L4 bake-off 2026-11-25: 155-215 s per still with model offload; still gets object structure wrong (seat on a pedestal, drawn border, melted hand truck).

qwen-image-2512.licence: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face model card cardData.license, read by the Mac 2026-11-25).
qwen-image-2512.card_note: A100 80 GB for the whole pipeline on the card; below 70 GB it needs sequential offload (the plain model offload moves the 40 GB transformer onto the card at once and ran out of memory on an L4, 2026-11-25). Sequential offload on an L4 is untested, so min_vram_gb stays 40 until it is.

chatgpt-image-codex.licence: OpenAI terms: the user owns the output and may use it commercially; files carry OpenAI's C2PA provenance, kept in the untouched originals.
chatgpt-image-codex.bakeoff: 2026-11-25 winner on anatomy, scale, night skies and no garbled text: 9 stills in about 6 min via codex exec. Faults: a face in 3 of 5 hero shots, 2 of 9 at an odd aspect (both now re-rolled by codex_stills.py).
chatgpt-image-codex.first_run: 2026-11-25 on the Mac: 4 hard shots in 4 Codex calls, no re-rolls, anatomy right on all, hero faceless; one cutaway drew a booth 1.1x the man's height against 1.3x asked, so sized shots now go to the scale marking page.
chatgpt-image-codex.note: Default for finished stills (owner, 2026-11-25: 'Chatgpt makes the best images by far and it's obvious', then 'Yeah let's do it' to redrawing every Survive Year 1 still). Open models are the fallback when the Codex allowance runs short or Codex is down. About 120 images an episode is roughly 10 to 15% of a week's allowance. Each run still passes --allow-codex.

moss-image-sft.licence: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face model card cardData.license, read by the Mac 2026-11-25).
moss-image-sft.status: broken 2026-11-25: render failed with 'module diffusers has no attribute MOSSImagePipeline'. The latest release, diffusers 0.43.0, has no MOSS pipeline (checked in its wheel), so the card's '0.38' is not enough. Setup now stops on this with a clear message; the Mac should read the card's loading code and set custom_pipeline, trust_remote_code or the package it names.
moss-image-sft.note: 5B; settings from the model card and community, not yet measured on our L4 (size, seconds per still, peak memory). The card's negative-branch skip at layer 22 is not passed: its argument name is unverified. The 8-step DMD LoRA (lodestones/Kromoss, CFG 1) would be a draft model and is not added.

excluded.HiDream-ai/HiDream-O1-Image: MIT, but it runs from its own repo with transformers and flash-attn, not a diffusers pipeline, so the stills route can't load it; add a route only if a bake-off shows it beats the Codex route.
excluded.Krea 2, FLUX 3 Klein: revenue-capped licences (under $1M / $5M); only with the owner's OK
